name: pathtracer
description: Physically-based Monte Carlo path tracer in TypeScript with next-event estimation + MIS, HDR image-based lighting (in-tree RGBE codec), GGX materials, textures, meshes, transforms and worker-thread rendering; zero runtime dependencies, deterministic PNG output, and a physics-validated test suite

scripts.assets:all: npm run build && node dist/tools/make-sky-hdr.js assets/sky.hdr && node dist/tools/make-knot-obj.js assets/knot.obj
scripts.render:all: npm run build && node dist/cli.js render scenes/cornell.json --out renders/cornell.png --workers 4 && node dist/cli.js render scenes/spheres.json --out renders/spheres.png --workers 4 && node dist/cli.js render scenes/night.json --out renders/night.png --workers 4 && node dist/cli.js render scenes/showcase.json --out renders/showcase.png --workers 4 && node dist/cli.js render scenes/skylight.json --out renders/skylight.png --workers 4
